name: VGMdb Concerts
description: Bangumi concert event metadata and artwork with verified VGMdb release supplements.
overview: Bangumi-first metadata and covers for Japanese concert movies.

versions.changelog: Bangumi is the primary source for concert metadata and cover artwork. VGMdb supplies verified commercial-release details and backup artwork. Stored IDs are revalidated, and plugin-owned artwork receives a one-time refresh. Targets Jellyfin 12.1 / .NET 10.
